definitions.explanation: A long, slender fish of the mackerel family (Scomberomorus niphonius) with soft, mild white flesh. Commonly grilled, especially after marinating in sweet white miso.

examples.japanese: サワラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}いた→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{給食|きゅうしょく}→給食：13800_kyuushoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サワラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西京焼|さいきょうや}きだった。
examples.english: Today's school lunch was Spanish mackerel grilled with sweet miso.

examples.japanese: {瀬戸内|せとうち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧サワラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{獲|と}れ{始|はじ}め、⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}ばれる→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: In the Seto Inland Sea area, Spanish mackerel start to be caught in spring and are welcomed as a taste of the season.

notes:
Written {鰆|さわら}, "fish" plus "spring", because it comes into the Seto Inland Sea to spawn in spring; in the Kanto region it is prized more in winter. A ⟦{出世魚|しゅっせうお}→出世魚：25796_shusseuo⟧ renamed as it grows: サゴシ → ナギ → サワラ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サワラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西京焼|さいきょうや}き: sawara grilled after marinating in sweet white miso
- サワラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧: salt-grilled sawara
- サワラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{照|て}り{焼|や}き→照り焼き：17668_teriyaki⟧: sawara teriyaki

USAGE:
さわら is also a cypress tree ({椹|さわら}), used for wooden tubs and buckets.
